Definition: middle voice from G1537 and G154; to demand (for trial):--desire.
BiblicalUsage: exaitéomai is a plain word for desire. In Luke 22:31, the text says "Satan hath desired [to have] you."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, exaitéomai, does its job quietly — desire — and I leave it at that.
